context: A boss mentors a uni intern
purpose: Teach: 貸し出し/同種/同業/各県/各党/引き継が/積み立て/役立て

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、機材貸し出しの管理、IT部門の基本だ。
lines.en: Ren — managing equipment loans is fundamental to IT operations.
lines.style: Direct, measured instruction. Sets the standard with quiet authority. Deliberate pace, each point landing with weight. This is not criticism; this is the shape of competence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。同種ソフトウェアの導入、共通化の利点、勉強します。
lines.en: Yes. I want to study how unified software systems work and why they matter.
lines.style: Quick intake of affirmation. Eager but careful — trying to absorb the whole shape of what's being taught. A little breathless. Respectful silence underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 同業他社の動向、業界紙で追える。
lines.en: You can track industry trends through trade publications.
lines.style: Practical pointer, not lecture. Slight upward tilt — this is useful information he's passing along. Conversational but deliberate. A hint of 'here's what I do.'

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 各県の支社の事例、勉強したいです。
lines.en: I'd like to look at how other branches across the prefectures have handled this.
lines.style: Thoughtful, self-directed. He's asking permission while showing he's thinking ahead. Soft landing on the request — respectful but genuine.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 各党の政策、企業活動への影響、把握しろ。
lines.en: You need to understand how government policy — across all parties — affects what we do as a company.
lines.style: Tightens slightly. This is wider scope than Ren was thinking. Clear, a bit firm but not unkind. The voice of someone who sees further than the immediate task.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 業務が引き継がれる際の文書化、重要ですね。
lines.en: The documentation when work gets handed over — that's where things either survive or fall apart.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. Ren has touched on something real. Measured, almost nodding in his voice. Small confirmation that he's understanding the deeper architecture.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若いうちから、積み立て、始めるんだ。
lines.en: Start building your reserves now, while you're young.
lines.style: Shifts register slightly — less about the job, more about the person. Genuine, almost parental conviction underneath. Steady, unhurried. The kind of advice that lands because it's not softened.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。インターンの経験、社会で役立てます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll use what I've learned here when I'm out in the world.
lines.style: Resolution in his voice. He's taking this seriously — the internship has become bigger than just a job. Quiet promise. Slight lift at the end, like he's setting something down carefully.
